lessons.role: Order two meals with a restaurant server
lessons.opening: なにを たべたいですか。
objectives: Ask both diners what they want to eat
Ask whether the vegetable dish contains meat using はいっていますか
Record one vegetable dish without meat and one fish dish
lessons.complication: One diner does not want meat, so the ingredient in the vegetable dish must be confirmed.
lessons.closure: Repeat both dishes and the no-meat detail before placing the order.

lessons.role: Negotiate an afternoon outing with a friend
lessons.opening: あしたの ごご いけますか。
objectives: Set a time the friend can make using さんじなら
Ask whether the room may be entered
Distinguish entry permission from the rule against indoor photos
lessons.complication: The friend assumes that permission to enter also permits photos.
lessons.closure: Confirm the three o’clock station meeting and the no-photo rule inside.

lessons.role: Prepare a study room with two classmates
lessons.opening: まず、へやを そうじしないと いけません。
objectives: List room cleaning and desk wiping as required tasks
Count the three notebooks and locate the pens
Ask whether opening the window is allowed and confirm when preparation is complete
lessons.complication: A classmate treats opening the window as a required task rather than a request for permission.
lessons.closure: Recap the completed required work and the window decision.

lessons.role: Explain a usual weekday and today’s delayed station meeting to a friend
lessons.opening: ふだんは あさ しちじに おきます。
objectives: Sequence at least three usual actions from morning to after work
Contrast the usual trip home with today’s planned meeting
Explain the train delay, quote the message, and recap the arrival and waiting
lessons.complication: A delayed train changes the plan after the usual workday.
lessons.closure: Describe the final meeting and trip home in order.

lessons.role: Guide a visitor from the station to a classroom
lessons.opening: この みちを まっすぐ いってください。
objectives: Give the straight-road and right-turn directions in order
Locate the school next to the station and the class on the second floor
Ask whether the visitor understands the route and can reach the school
lessons.complication: The visitor knows the school’s location but not which floor the class uses.
lessons.closure: Confirm the second-floor classroom and the visitor’s route.

lessons.role: Discuss current work and tomorrow’s visit with a friend
lessons.opening: いま、ほんを よんでいます。
objectives: Describe reading and Aki’s writing as actions happening now
Separate tomorrow’s intended meeting from the scheduled afternoon station trip
Say that the meeting time has not yet been decided with まだ きめていません
lessons.complication: The friend treats the undecided meeting time as a past decision.
lessons.closure: Confirm that another call will happen tonight to set the time.

lessons.role: Clarify which book should be handed to Aki
lessons.opening: この ほんは たなかさんのですか。
objectives: Identify Tanaka’s book and ask permission to show it
Notice that Aki’s own book is also present
Ask どの ほんの ことですか when the final handoff reference is unclear
lessons.complication: Two books are now in view and an omitted reference could mean either one.
lessons.closure: Name the intended book before handing it over.

lessons.role: Tell a classmate about yesterday’s Kyoto outing
lessons.opening: きのう ともだちと きょうとへ いきました。
objectives: Sequence the early station trip, train ride, lunch, and bookshop visit
Use polite past forms to describe completed actions
Answer where the new book was bought
lessons.complication: The listener asks whether the book was bought at the station or the bookshop.
lessons.closure: Confirm that the book was bought at the bookshop.

lessons.role: Compare old and current travel habits with a friend
lessons.opening: むかし、まいにち がっこうまで あるきました。
objectives: Describe the former repeated walk with a friend
Separate yesterday’s rainy train trip from that old habit
Explain that walking still happens now, while rainy days call for the train
lessons.complication: The listener assumes the one rainy train trip replaced walking entirely.
lessons.closure: Restate the present walk-versus-rainy-day train pattern.

lessons.role: Complete a multi-turn after-class conversation with Aki
objectives: Greet Aki and ask for an unclear word to be said slowly
Confirm the meaning in context and plan tomorrow’s meeting
Recall yesterday’s meeting at the same station and close politely
lessons.complication: The kana いってください could mean say or go; the request concerns pronouncing a word.
lessons.closure: Confirm the one o’clock station meeting and say また あした。
